hero.description: Four months. 12 phases. A real client at every stage. You finish holding campaigns you ran, numbers you own, and answers that hold up in an interview.

faqs.question: What is Treqo's New Age Digital Marketing Program?
faqs.answer: A 4-month intensive, practitioner-led program where you build real campaigns using live marketing budgets for actual brands, graduating with an execution-backed portfolio.

faqs.question: Who is this program best suited for?
faqs.answer: Aspiring performance marketers, agency founders, growth leads, and creative strategists who want real execution skills instead of theoretical lecture slides.

faqs.question: Do we get hands-on experience with real budgets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every student manages real ad spend across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and automation workflows with direct practitioner supervision.

faqs.question: How do I apply for the upcoming cohort?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Apply Now' button on our website, fill in your background and goals, and our admissions team will schedule a 1-on-1 interview call.

whyTreqqo.description: 70% doing, 30% theory enforced, not aspirational. A right answer with no evidence behind it does not pass. You submit four things and defend them out loud.

submissions.title: The problem
submissions.description: One sentence. If it takes three, you haven't found the problem yet.

submissions.title: The market logic
submissions.description: Why this market behaves the way you claim. Assertion is not logic.

submissions.title: The experiment
submissions.description: Something small, live and measurable. Report it even when it flopped.

submissions.title: The revenue plan
submissions.description: Where the money comes from, how much, and by when.

sixDecisions.title: Six decisions that make Treqo different.

decisions.title: 70% doing
decisions.description: The ratio is enforced, not aspirational. Every phase closes on a live problem, and theory alone doesn't clear it.

decisions.title: Clients with something to lose
decisions.description: You work on brands with real customers to disappoint. Fictional case studies teach confidence about risk you never carried.

decisions.title: A fixed sequence
decisions.description: You can't position a brand you haven't understood. No à-la-carte modules the order is the curriculum.

decisions.title: AI from phase one
decisions.description: In the workflow from the start, not bolted on as a final module nobody remembers.

decisions.title: Defended out loud
decisions.description: Your numbers, your logic, your revenue plan pushed on in front of people. That's the interview rehearsal.

decisions.title: 50 seats, capped
decisions.description: Small enough that there's nowhere to hide, and small enough that we know what you're bad at by week three.
